problem_statement: A mDNS service can be registered with a NULL host name to indicate that the service belongs to the local host (this device itself). When a service is registered in this way, the announced SRV record must advertise the local host name. With the unfixed code, registering a service whose host name is NULL produces an SRV announcement carrying an empty host name instead of the local host name, so the advertised record does not reflect the local host and a validator checking the SRV record against the local host name fails.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
